definitions: strong disagreement with or protest against something, such as a plan, idea, or system
a political party or group that is not part of the government and that is critical of the government's policies
the act of opposing or resisting someone or something
a contrast or juxtaposition of two things that are different or opposite
examples: There was strong opposition to the new law.
The leader of the Opposition criticised the government's budget.
They faced fierce opposition from local residents.
The opposition between good and evil is a common theme.
